_note: Copy this file outside the repo (e.g. ~/leadengine-sender.json), fill in every [bracket], then run: python3 -m leadengine first-run --sender ~/leadengine-sender.json. Passwords never go here: they go in your terminal (docs/FIRST_RUN.md step 4).

sender.name: [Your full name, as it should appear in the From line]
sender.address: [A real postal address or PO box: street, city, state ZIP]
sender.offer: [One sentence: what you do for practices and how fast]

mail.from_email: [the address you send from: the mailbox you log in to]
